rationale: Shan brings embodied AI robotics expertise from Ruyi Dynamics—operating at the intersection of robot hardware, AI software, and industrial deployment—while Meriç is a Staff Product Designer at Shield AI with deep experience in autonomous systems. Meriç's technical foundation (Python, C#, Arduino) and product design perspective could help translate Ruyi's hardware-software stack into deployable systems, and Shan's end-to-end robotics experience could ground Shield AI's autonomous systems work in real-world constraints.
intro_message: Shan, meet Meriç Dağlı—a Staff Product Designer at Shield AI who works in autonomous systems and could bring valuable product and technical perspective to embodied AI deployment challenges.
